findings.label: Runtime-side session-id fallback length
findings.detail: _resolve_session_id generates uuid.uuid4().hex (32 chars) when the session header is absent, but AgentCore's runtimeSessionId minimum is 33 chars. This only fires on a direct Runtime call that bypasses the thin API (which always sends a 36-char uuid4()), and the Runtime only echoes the value rather than re-sending it, so it cannot break the thin-API path. Operator should confirm the direct-invoke fallback during the live gate or widen the generated id.

findings.label: Cross-VM HITL restore under live conditions
findings.detail: The filter_restored_tool_context=False contract for pending-write sessions is designed to keep the open toolUse in the restored message list across a cold process boundary, but this is the design's designated live verification gate and is not provable offline. The deploy runbook section C.5 already schedules the live HITL check.
